en-US.description: A lightweight, cross-platform remote desktop software with support for Web Client access
en-US.longDescription:
CrossDesk is a lightweight cross-platform remote desktop software.
CrossDesk is an experimental application of MiniRTC, a lightweight cross-platform real-time audio and video transmission library. MiniRTC provides fundamental capabilities including network traversal (RFC5245), video software/hardware encoding and decoding (H264/AV1), audio encoding/decoding (Opus), signaling interaction, network congestion control, and transmission encryption (SRTP).

zh-CN.description: 一款支持 Web 客户端访问的轻量级跨平台远程桌面软件。
zh-CN.longDescription:
CrossDesk 是一个轻量级的跨平台远程桌面软件，支持 Web 端控制远程设备。
CrossDesk 是 MiniRTC 实时音视频传输库的实验性应用。MiniRTC 是一个轻量级的跨平台实时音视频传输库。它具有网络透传（RFC5245），视频软硬编解码（H264/AV1），音频编解码（Opus），信令交互，网络拥塞控制，传输加密（SRTP）等基础能力。
zh-CN.name: CrossDesk
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
新增功能与改进：*
1. 新增 CrossDesk MCP，让 AI Agent 在授权下查看和操作远程电脑，支持截图、键鼠输入、剪贴板、文件传输、远端声音、多设备会话与多显示器操作。
2. 桌面端新增双栏文件浏览窗口，支持浏览本机与远端目录、双向传输文件和文件夹，并改善拖拽反馈与预览。
3. 新增最小化时暂停视频的可配置选项。
4. 新增远端输入执行确认、画面变化等待及桌面自动化能力，支持在具备相应能力的远端直接打开网址、启动应用、读取及操作可访问性元素。
5. 完善 Windows 安装版无人值守功能，后台服务与桌面客户端共用设备身份和连接密码，支持登录前远控及登录后的功能衔接。
6. Windows 主窗口与远控窗口采用独立任务栏分组，并改善 macOS 和 Linux 上的窗口切换、最小化及关闭行为。
7. 新增反馈与建议入口及诊断日志导出，可将日志与基本版本信息保存为 ZIP，方便反馈问题。
8. 新增远端显示器分辨率调整，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux X11 被控端；桌面和移动控制端可记住各设备、各显示器的选择，最后一个控制端断开后恢复原显示模式。
9. 支持在 Codex 右侧内置浏览器显示远端实时画面，并为 MCP Apps 提供兼容预览。
10. MCP 新增批量动作与 Agent 状态监看，减少重复调用；优化 Agent 光标样式与移动动画。
11. 新增 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏支持，并将插件、MCP 与原生程序合并为一个安装包。
问题修复：
1. 改善 MCP 会话稳定性，完善初始信令连接恢复与连接失败提示。
2. 修复部分 OpenGL 环境下的画面渲染异常，完善 NVDEC 运行时故障恢复及视频解码回退。
3. 修复窗口显示前定位不正确导致的闪烁。
4. Android 支持用户安装的 CA 证书，改善使用自签发证书的自托管连接。
5. 修复 Windows 键盘捕获恢复后的修饰键状态异常。
6. 修复 iOS 音频播放缓冲格式问题、较早系统版本上的连接崩溃；更新检查改为依据 App Store 已发布版本。
7. 改善 macOS 升级时的权限保留。
8. 修复 Windows 升级后的服务路径、开机自启状态及 Linux 自启动与连接异常；桌面端守护进程设置保存后即时生效。
9. 修复旧剪贴板缓存阻止远端写入的问题。
10. 修复 Windows 无显示器会话中的分辨率记录与恢复问题，避免后台服务阻塞系统关机。
11. 修复设备在线状态被心跳覆盖的问题。
12. 修复操作画面菜单时菜单意外关闭或误向远端发送输入的问题。
13. 修复显示器分辨率变化后的主窗口尺寸异常。
14. 修复网页会话后原生客户端连接可能崩溃的问题。
15. 修复不同控制传输方式下的网页端文件浏览兼容性。
升级说明：
1. iOS 最低支持版本为 iOS 16.0。GitHub 提供的 iOS 包未签名，需要自行签名安装；App Store 更新以商店实际发布情况为准。
2. Windows 登录前无人值守需要安装版 Release 客户端。Linux 远端分辨率调整需要 X11 和 RandR 支持，暂不支持 Wayland 或 XWayland 采集。
3. 本次同步发布 CLI、MCP 及 DeepSeek Harness 插件 0.2.0。使用新增自动化和分辨率控制功能时，建议将相关客户端同步升级到 1.7.6；实际可用功能取决于远端系统、权限和应用支持。

New Features and Improvements:
1. Added CrossDesk MCP, allowing AI agents to view and control authorized remote computers, with screenshots, keyboard and mouse input, clipboard access, file transfers, remote audio, concurrent device sessions and multi-display operations.
2. Added a dual-pane desktop file browser for local and remote directories, with bidirectional file and folder transfers, improved drag feedback and previews.
3. Added a configurable option to pause video when minimized.
4. Added remote input acknowledgments, visual-change waits and desktop automation. Supported remote systems can open URLs, launch applications, and inspect or interact with accessibility elements directly.
5. Improved unattended access in installed Windows builds. The background service and desktop client share the same device identity and connection password, with remote access before login and user-session features after login.
6. Added separate Windows taskbar groups for the main and remote control windows, and improved window switching, minimization and closing behavior on macOS and Linux.
7. Added a feedback entry and diagnostic log export, allowing logs and basic version information to be saved as a ZIP archive for troubleshooting.
8. Added remote display resolution controls for Windows, macOS and Linux X11 hosts. Desktop and mobile controllers remember selections per device and display, while hosts restore the original display mode after the last controller disconnects.
9. Added live remote desktop views in the Codex built-in sidebar browser, with a compatible preview fallback for MCP Apps.
10. Added batched MCP actions and agent activity monitoring to reduce repeated tool calls, and improved the agent cursor appearance and movement animation.
11. Added DeepSeek Harness sidebar support and bundled the plugin, MCP and native runtime into a single installation package.
Bug Fixes:
1. Improved MCP session stability, initial signaling connection recovery and connection failure messages.
2. Fixed rendering issues in some OpenGL environments and improved recovery from NVDEC runtime failures and video decoder fallback.
3. Fixed window flicker caused by positioning windows after they became visible.
4. Added support for user-installed CA certificates on Android, improving connections to self-hosted servers using private certificate authorities.
5. Fixed incorrect Windows modifier states after keyboard capture recovery.
6. Fixed iOS audio playback buffer format issues and connection crashes on older system versions. Update checks now follow published App Store versions.
7. Improved macOS permission preservation during upgrades.
8. Fixed Windows service paths after upgrades, autostart state handling, and Linux autostart and connection issues. Desktop watchdog settings now take effect immediately after saving.
9. Fixed remote clipboard writes blocked by stale cache.
10. Fixed display resolution tracking and restoration in headless Windows sessions, and prevented background services from blocking system shutdown.
11. Fixed incorrect device presence updates from heartbeats.
12. Fixed video settings menus closing unexpectedly or forwarding unintended input to the remote computer.
13. Fixed incorrect main-window sizing after display resolution changes.
14. Fixed potential crashes when native clients connect after web sessions.
15. Fixed web file browsing compatibility across control transports.
Upgrade Notes:
1. The minimum supported iOS version is iOS 16.0. The iOS archive on GitHub is unsigned and requires your own signing. App Store update availability follows the actual store release.
2. Unattended access before Windows login requires an installed Release build. Remote resolution changes on Linux require X11 and RandR; Wayland and XWayland capture are currently unsupported.
3. CLI, MCP and the DeepSeek Harness plugin are released alongside this version as 0.2.0. Upgrade the relevant clients to 1.7.6 to use the new automation and resolution controls. Available capabilities depend on the remote operating system, permissions and application support.
